                        new_total = (base_total - fr_before - route_cost(tr)) + fr_after_cost + tr_after_cost
                        delta = new_total - base_total
                        if delta + 1e-9 < best_delta:
                            best_delta = delta
                            best_move = (fi, ti, ni, pos)
        if best_move is None:
            return False
        fi, ti, ni, pos = best_move
        node = routes[fi][ni]
        # apply move
        routes[fi].pop(ni)
        loads[fi] -= demands[node]
        routes[ti].insert(pos, node)
        loads[ti] += demands[node]
        # cleanup empty routes (keep deterministic order)
        i = 0
        while i < len(routes):
            if not routes[i]:
                routes.pop(i)
                loads.pop(i)
            else:
                i += 1
        return True

    # Multiple passes until no improving relocate; keep it bounded
    # (deterministic and avoids excessive runtime)
    for _ in range(3):
        if not relocate_improve(routes, loads):
            break
        # also re-run 2-opt on affected routes conservatively: all routes are few typically
        for r in routes:
            two_opt_improve(r)

    # Ensure return format: list of routes, no depot
    # (routes already exclude depot)
    return routes
